summary: Flat kerb beside a corner house 9 m away, with bus zone signs.
reasons: Bus zone signs on this kerb

best_section.where: east kerb of Hillsdon Road just north of the side street junction

drivers.seclusion: Large dwelling 9 m from the kerb; shops and cafes 15-37 m to the north.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed road with a few cars parked on the east kerb; room at the kerb, but a bus zone applies.
drivers.traffic: Busy through road past a small shopping strip.
drivers.convention: Cars park here, but two Bus Zone signs mark the kerb.

sun_shade: Open from the west; the large house and a few trees shade the east side.
